description: This Java source file implements the ExternalAssetOwnersWriteService interface, providing methods for handling external asset owner transfers such as sale, intermediary sale, buyback, and cancellation. It contains logic for validating requests, managing transfer states, creating transfer records, and enforcing business rules related to external transfers within the Fineract platform.

classes.name: ExternalAssetOwnersWriteServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ExternalAssetOwnersWriteService interface, providing methods to manage external asset owners and their transfer operations with various validation and business rules.

methods.name: intermediarySaleLoanByLoanId
methods.description: Handles the process of initiating an intermediary sale of a loan by its ID, including validation, transfer creation, and state checks.

methods.name: saleLoanByLoanId
methods.description: Processes a standard sale of a loan by its ID, validating input, loan status, and creating a transfer record.

methods.name: buybackLoanByLoanId
methods.description: Facilitates the buyback of a loan, validating the transfer parameters and creating a buyback transfer record.

methods.name: cancelTransactionById
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing transfer transaction based on transfer ID, updating its status accordingly.
